identity_with_main_run.statement: NOT PROVEN that these are byte-identical to the initial weights the main run started from. The main run never saved its pre-training policy: train_ppo writes gen000 only after the first PPO update, and keep_latest=5 pruned gen000 as well. No main-run file holds the initial weights, so no direct SHA comparison is possible.
indirect_evidence: Replay of generation 0 at be36450 with the main-run arguments (n3 start 1000000, n4 start 1300000, 1024 episodes, 32 workers, seed 20260812) on csi: gen000.diagnostics.json is equal to the recovered main-run file except evaluation_seconds (canonical sha256 n3 9794cf6679692c448380941a05f5415b4aed869ca047a98297bed87f47d1d75a, n4 47465eb195dbefa53a6ce9271628b0a06d9c7e8b088f3e16aa5cb373b161a2b5 on both sides). These diagnostics are the value head of the pre-update net over all 1024 gen-0 trajectories.
The gen-0 log line (decisions, policy_loss, value_loss, entropy, total_loss, clip_frac, approx_kl) is identical to the main-run log for both n (only decisions_per_second differs).
The replay's --profile-dir dump of the net train_ppo actually constructed (evidence/gen000/initial_model.pt) is tensor-equal to the saved initial.weights.pt for n=3 and n=4.
